# Problem 1

### 1. Simulation setup

I draw each person's birthday independently from 365 equally likely days, so the same day can come up more than once in a room.

### 2. Simulate one room

```{r sim_birthday}
sim_birthday = function(n) {
  birthdays = sample(1:365, n, replace = TRUE)
  n_distinct(birthdays) < n
}
```

### 3. Estimate the probability for each group size

```{r birthday_prob}
birthday_sims =
  expand_grid(group_size = 2:50, iter = 1:10000) |>
  mutate(shared = map_lgl(group_size, sim_birthday))

birthday_prob =
  birthday_sims |>
  group_by(group_size) |>
  summarize(prob = mean(shared))
```
